98% of what Ive played of this game is on multiplayer exhile mod. Ive only booted arma single player to ♥♥♥♥ around with the vehicles and learn how to fly heliciopters. Its probably a good game, but they have a lot of issues they didnt even fix from arma 2, that carried into arma 3. View distance is really weird in this game, the ground moves up or down depending on how far away you are, so if your target is around 400-700m away, they can go prone and they disappear below the ground, but if they are out 900+ the ground appears almost 5ft below them. At that distance, they (and the bush they are hiding in) look like they are floating. It makes shortrange sniping more difficult and long range sniping super easy. Bullets still know where the "real" ground is, so if they are hiding behind a small mound or something, you wont see it, but the bullet will, and will just bounce, even tho the scope and your zeroing says it shoulda been a headshot. 

Ghillie suits dont offer any value at long range other than thermal protection. Anybody who can spot a rock, can spot a ghillie, but that same suit blends in real nice with the locally rendered grass, so if you're within 30m or so, you might as well be a ghost.

Vehicles physics is still pretty nonexhistent. Flying is really easy, and very forgiving of mistakes. 
If youve never played an arma game before, or the Arma 2 DayzMod from 2009, this game is probably not for you.
